answer_2.quote: We adopt a widely-used metric -Attack Success Rate (ASR) -and design a new metric -Non-detectable Attack Success Rate (NASR) -to evaluate attack performance. We also report the Percentage of Perturbed Words (%Words) and Semantic Similarity (SS) to evaluate the impact of text perturbation.

answer_4.quote: Given that our goal is to generate high-quality adversarial examples that preserve the original semantics and remain imperceptible to humans, we perform human evaluations to assess the adversarial examples generated by DA 3 ... These evaluations focus on grammar, prediction accuracy, and semantic preservation on SST-2 and MRPC datasets.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters evaluate grammar correctness (scored 1-5), make predictions for sentiment or equivalence, and assess semantic preservation (similar, ambiguous, or dissimilar).
